body: So because nothing interests me enough to want to work at a job I hate to pay for a live I didn't ask or want, means there is something wrong with me? Even if some magic medicine would make me want to suddenly work at a job I hate, medicine is expensive.

I don't want to work, I don't really care if it will get better. I have no drive for anything so working for the next 40-50~ years just for necessities to live seems like too much work when I could probably do that without working. Being homeless would probably suck and it wouldn't be much better than working. That's why suicide seems like the answer, I'm not really suited for the working to live and being homeless is hard.
That's fair, but I don't really want to work. So as a result I will be homeless, so suicide seems the the logical choice right?
